publisher: Torrance County, NM (assessor parcel data hosted by gispro@sma, 2018 layer TORRANCE_CO_201804)
notes: Assessor parcel polygons, 2018 snapshot (about 28,245 features in the full layer; the layer is dated 2018). Filter Acres < 1000 is required: parcels over 1,000 acres (large ranches) have geometry that fails the validity check in this source, so they are excluded; the adapter therefore omits those large rural parcels. Spatial reference NM State Plane feet, converted by the query. Owner is the assessor name field; address is not populated in the source for most parcels.
